2609.25806.title: When Are Aggregate Agent Traces Diagnosable? Traffic-Governed Interpretation and Calibrated Abstention
2609.25806.paper_summary: Runtime traces can appear transparent, but a closed-loop policy determines which states are visited and which failures become visible. We study a simulated hotel-pricing agent mapping time, inventory, and market state to discrete price actions under varying demand regimes. A fault may leave no aggregate trace when the policy rarely visits affected cells. We treat entry into aggregate-only fault interpretation as a diagnosability decision preceding scoring or localization. A reference-map gate requires repeated clean-policy support; a matched runtime gate then requires joint support in clean and current streams. Signal analysis occurs only after both pass. We calibrate false admission on a disjoint clean stream at the physical-component level and model detection by affected clean traffic rather than nominal cell coverage. In a frozen one-shot heldout, 55/72 (76.4%) regime-component units were reference-admitted, representing 20 physical components; 54/55 passed matched runtime admission, while the rejected unit abstained. Stable false admission was 0/20, with a one-sided exact 95% upper bound of 0.1391, meeting the frozen 0.20 criterion. Across 540 repeated unit-arm rows nested in those 20 clusters, affected clean traffic reduced negative log likelihood by 29.3% relative to cell coverage, a gain of 0.1264 nats per row (cluster-bootstrap 95% interval [0.0593, 0.1918]). Adding mask family and its interaction improved log loss by 0.0015 nats per row (one-sided upper bound 0.0066), below the frozen 0.01 practical-sufficiency margin. A development audit found that exact minimum hitting set and greedy selection chose identical supports in 12/12 scenarios because singleton evidence had resolved the conflicts. The result is a bounded rule for interpreting aggregate agent behavior: first establish exposure, then score change, and abstain when the trace cannot support the claim.
2609.25806.paper_summary_zh: 執行時追蹤可能看起來是透明的，但閉環策略決定了哪些狀態被訪問以及哪些故障變得可見。我們研究了一個模擬的酒店定價代理，將時間、庫存和市場狀態映射到在不同需求體系下的離散價格行動。當策略很少訪問受影響的單元時，故障可能不會留下任何總體痕跡。我們將進入僅限總體故障解釋視為一個診斷決策，這在評分或定位之前進行。參考地圖閘需要重複的乾淨策略支持；匹配的執行時閘則需要在乾淨和當前流中的聯合支持。信號分析僅在兩者都通過後進行。我們在物理組件層面上對不相交的乾淨流進行了虛假接受的校準，並通過受影響的乾淨流量而非名義單元覆蓋來建模檢測。在一次凍結的一次性保留中，55/72（76.4%）的體系組件單元被參考接受，代表20個物理組件；54/55通過了匹配的執行時接受，而被拒絕的單元則選擇不參加。穩定的虛假接受為0/20，具有單側精確的95%上限為0.1391，滿足凍結的0.20標準。在這20個集群中嵌套的540個重複單元臂行中，受影響的乾淨流量相對於單元覆蓋減少了29.3%的負對數似然，每行（集群自助法95%區間[0.0593, 0.1918]）增益為0.1264 nats。添加掩碼家族及其交互作用使每行的對數損失改善了0.0015 nats（單側上限0.0066），低於凍結的0.01實用充分性邊際。一項開發審核發現，精確的最小擊中集和貪婪選擇在12/12個場景中選擇了相同的支持，因為單一證據已解決了衝突。結果是一個解釋總體代理行為的有界規則：首先建立暴露，然後評分變化，當痕跡無法支持該主張時則選擇不參加。
2609.25806.author: Peiying Zhu et.al.
